proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5020 chādi explicitly gives Sindhi/Lahnda/Punjabi chāī ashes, Assamese sāi and Bengali chāi, as well as Hindi chāī. The selected cāī/caī/chai/tʃhai/tśai/ʦaī survey forms fit this ash noun, with initial aspiration and affricate notation retained as regional/transcription qualifications. The source ash/ashes distinction and local transmission remain open. Exact response: chai.
